description: Action dropdown menu triggered by a button, supporting icons and keyboard navigation. Items are rendered via TmDropdownItem children. The menu is a top-layer TmOverlayPanel; SelectItemAsync closes it (and yields a render) BEFORE invoking OnSelect, so a dialog opened by the handler never renders under the still-open menu and the first Escape reaches the dialog.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Optional leading icon on the trigger button.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Fires when a dropdown item is selected (value = item key).

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Preferred side of the trigger the menu opens on. Default Bottom.

parameters.name: Align
parameters.description: Cross-axis alignment of the menu against the trigger. Default Start.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Gap in pixels between trigger and menu. Default 4.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the menu presents on a narrow viewport. Auto follows the viewport scope: a content-height bottom sheet titled with the trigger text on mobile, the anchored popover otherwise. A forced value renders without measuring (since 2.9.2).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the menu presentation resolves from. Auto follows the viewport scope; a forced value never measures, so a test can render a mode without a DOM (since 2.9.2).

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement. Desktop unless the host says otherwise (since 2.9.2).

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes (the initial value is not a change). Never pair with LayoutMode — a two-way bind would pin the mode (since 2.9.2).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

examples.title: Basic dropdown with items
examples.code:
<TmDropdown Text="Actions" OnSelect="HandleSelect">
    <TmDropdownItem Value="edit" Icon="edit">Edit</TmDropdownItem>
    <TmDropdownItem Value="delete" Icon="trash">Delete</TmDropdownItem>
</TmDropdown>

examples.title: Dropdown with leading icon
examples.code:
<TmDropdown Text="Options" Icon="settings" OnSelect="HandleSelect" Disabled="false">
    <TmDropdownItem Value="export">Export</TmDropdownItem>
    <TmDropdownItem Value="print">Print</TmDropdownItem>
</TmDropdown>
